title: better-hammer
description: Tired of a cluttered inventory full of different tools? This "Ultimate Hammer" mod brings you the ultimate convenience!
body:
Tired of a cluttered inventory full of different tools? This "Ultimate Hammer" mod brings you the ultimate convenience! It introduces a powerful hammer system that perfectly inherits the functions of swords, pickaxes, and axes. Whether it's chopping trees, mining ores, or fighting mobs, one hammer does it all, eliminating the hassle of constantly switching tools.
To meet your survival needs at every stage, the mod offers 6 tiers of hammers: Wood, Stone, Iron, Gold, Diamond, and Netherite. Each material retains its original durability and stats, ensuring you have the perfect tool from day one to endgame. With just one hotbar slot, you can handle any situation. Add this mod now and experience the thrill of conquering the world with a single swing!
